report.summary: Reviewed daedalus/kairos/orchestrate.py chunk 1/1; no docstrings or comments, minor robustness observations.
risks: line 43 | low | _infer_paths swallows OSError, silently omitting paths that exist but are unreadable; a path that exists but raises OSError will be reported as absent rather than unreadable | Confirm by test with unreadable directory on a platform where exists() raises OSError

handoff.purpose: Prepare a user task: infer paths, route agent, record memory event, optionally enqueue Claude second opinion.

symbols.name: _infer_paths
symbols.note: Internal helper; extracts existing paths from a message string relative to repo_root. Strips backticks, commas, and quote/bracket characters; treats tokens with '/' or '\' or a dot in the name as path-like; resolves relative candidates against repo_root; deduplicates preserving order; silently skips candidates that raise OSError.

symbols.name: prepare_task
symbols.note: Public entry point. Resolves repo root, loads project data, trims/infers paths, routes agent, collects status, appends a MemoryEvent (repository mutation), optionally enqueues a Claude request (network/process side effects), and returns a result dict.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: CLI wrapper for prepare_task; parses arguments and prints JSON result to stdout. Calls prepare_task, which may enqueue and append memory.

symbols.name: MAX_TODO_CHARS
symbols.note: Imported from ..token_policy; used to trim the todo text in the memory event.

observations.what: _infer_paths silently swallows OSError from candidate.exists(), meaning a path that exists but raises OSError (e.g., permission denied on some platforms) is omitted from the returned list instead of being reported as unreadable.
The module contains no docstrings or comments; only argparse help strings are present, which are user-facing but not claims about program behaviour.
